name: IH-Challenge
description: A reinforcement learning training dataset designed to improve instruction hierarchy robustness in large language models, helping them prioritize conflicting instructions from system, developer, user, and tool sources. It supports training against instruction conflicts, reducing unsafe behavior and improving helpfulness.
reputation: A newly proposed training dataset for instruction-hierarchy robustness with no established benchmark standing yet.
notes: Dataset released publicly on Hugging Face; improves instruction hierarchy robustness and reduces unsafe behavior.
